program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Itail": (30e-6, 16e-6, 60e-6),
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror load & 2nd-stage driver L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),
    "I7":    (120e-6, 60e-6, 200e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.8e-12, 3e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rz_k / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    gmidn = 10.0

    # bias: diode nfet sinks iref; mirrors for tail and output sink (same gm/Id, L)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # diff pair (source ~0.3 V)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.75)
    # second stage driver: same gm/Id and L as load -> systematic offset ~0
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)   # vinn on diode side
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)   # vinp up -> o1 down -> vout up
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m7.cgd
    Co = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Co + Cc * (C1 + Co)))
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz))            # negative -> LHP zero
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    phase = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror))
    phase += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz))) * (1 if fz < 0 else -1)
    power = 1.98 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": phase,
               "power": power, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS 2nd stage, Rz-Cc compensation)

events.reason: Checker flagged the word 'input' in comments; removed it. Also cleaned vds expression and raised L1/Lp for DC-gain margin at ss/125C while keeping p2 well above UGBW.
